title.zh: 字节Seed单列AI安全部门：严林直报吴永辉，重点防范Agent越权
title.en: 字节Seed单列AI安全部门：严林直报吴永辉，重点防范Agent越权

current_state.zh: ByteDance Seed is establishing a standalone Model-Alignment & Preparedness department under alignment lead Yan Lin reporting directly to Seed head Wu Yonghui, tasked with preventing Agent authorization overreach and CBRN misuse through model specs, safety evaluations, alignment training and third-party assessment.
